rationale:
JOB 2, the `imports` RELATIONSHIP type, which was absent from the analyzer while ParseResult.imports was carrying every import. Expected values here are read off the WRITTEN SOURCE above - four import declarations on lines 3, 4, 5 and 6, the package on line 1, the class on line 8 - not off an analyzer run, which is what the honesty contract's oracle rule asks of an expectation file.

WHAT THE EDGE IS. `imports` is the DEPENDENCY: this file needs java.util.List, java.util.Map, java.util.Collections.sort and groovy.transform.CompileStatic. `references` is the MENTION of the same declaration and both survive, because they answer different questions - dropping either loses one. The import-edges fixture already pins the `references` half; this one pins the `imports` half and asserts the half did not replace it.

WHY THE SOURCE IS THE PACKAGE AND NOT THE PRIMARY TYPE. bb_graph's per-file dependencies section is one exact query (src/lsp/graph_request.ts:291-297): relationship_type = 'imports' AND source_symbol_id IS NULL AND target_symbol_id IS NULL AND source_external = <the file>. parallel-indexer.ts:3481-3485 only writes source_external = the repo-relative path when the source resolves to NO symbol in the file AND metadata.fileLevel is true. Sourcing the edge at the class Dep would make source_symbol_id resolve, so no source_external would ever be written and the dependency would be unanswerable for every file whose class name matches its file name - which is the normal case in Groovy. `forbidRelationships` pins that, because the wrong choice produces a number that still looks populated.

THE THREE SUB-LABELS come from the ANONYMOUS TOKENS of the import declaration (this pinned grammar declares the wildcard as `asterisk` and the static marker as `static`), so a form the source does not write cannot be asserted.

`fileLevel: true` is the storage flag and is pinned here because a fixture that checked only the label would pass against an edge the indexer could not store.

expectRelationships.note: the MENTION half survives the new DEPENDENCY half

forbidRelationships.note: a truncated module path names a package, not an import
the wildcard is a FORM on the parent module, not part of the target
sourcing the dependency at the primary type resolves source_symbol_id, so parallel-indexer never writes source_external and bb_graph's file-level dependencies query cannot return it
this file declares a package; the lane sentinel must not stand in for it
